name: usage-dashboard
description: Token and cost dashboard from ZCode rollout logs at ~/.zcode/cli/rollout/model-io-sess_*.jsonl. Parses JSONL turns (tolerating missing or renamed fields), aggregates tokens per day, per session, and per model, estimates cost only when a user-supplied per-model price JSON is given (no hardcoded prices), and emits a markdown table plus an optional self-contained HTML report.
